tools.name: calculate_astrocartography_lines
tools.description: Compute astrocartography planetary lines (MC, IC, AC/AS, DC/DS) from a birth date, local time, timezone, and reference coordinates using the astronomical ephemeris engine. Returns MC/IC meridian longitudes, horizon AC/DC longitudes at the reference latitude, planetary subpoints, zodiac signs, and ne

tools.name: evaluate_location_astrocartography
tools.description: Analyze how a specific target coordinate aligns with a birth chart: returns all planetary lines within 1,000 km sorted by proximity, plain-English line descriptions, goal alignment scores (balanced, love, career, home), and the relocated Ascendant and Midheaven.
